note: Moves safeStringify out of the playground prompts logic into the shared llm_analytics utils module and imports it from there.
Adds Discord destination support and replaces template-id maps with an AlertDestinationTemplate enum; code stays split between common/alerting and posthog/alerting.
Removes the CUSTOMER_ANALYTICS_EVENT_STREAM flag and gates the event stream behind the existing customer-analytics-csp flag.
Moves used/sorted property and condition derivations into kea selectors and drops the IIFE, but keeps the custom table and key formatting instead of PropertiesTable.
Matches events by distinct_id when person_id is missing and only edits a metric help string; metrics stay in the shared metrics file.
Drops the last_task foreign key from the automation migration, keeping last_task_run; also switches to cron_expression and adds a one-to-one task link.
Removes hardcoded per-product route imports from posthog/api and auto-discovers each product's routes.register_routes via INSTALLED_APPS.
Renames the config field and env var to cohort_register_transfer_enabled / COHORT_REGISTER_TRANSFER_ENABLED and updates tests and docs.
Deletes both optional-scopes migrations while reworking CIMD scope handling, but adds no single merged replacement migration in this commit.
Replaces the hand-rolled Turnstile script loader with the @marsidev/react-turnstile library component and removes the global typings.
Model's rebalance action now calls the production protocol::plan_rebalance extracted from the coordinator instead of inline diff logic.
parse_and_authenticate now returns the body library in its tuple and the handler uses it instead of calling stamp_body_sdk_info again.
Deletes the duplicated analytics and error-tracking producer files and moves producer registration into a shared ingestion/common module.
Only trims comments from the trace search feature; the searchTerm field keeps its generic name.
Forces the top random bit for consistent token length and rewrites the length test; does not move the test character set into prod code.
Replaces the local ScanTimer and sibling timers with a shared MetricTimer from observability metrics taking the histogram name.
Adds api_token to cached token auth data and changes the generic validator's return tuple; the team-scoped validator keeps its own cache-loading prelude.
Removes duplicated team/name/prompt/repository/integration/run fields from TaskAutomation and exposes them as properties read from the linked Task.
Adds a keep-in-sync comment in both feature flag group definitions; the duplicated group definitions are not collapsed.
Introduces WorkerAssignments/WorkerSubBatchBuilder helper structs so both pinned and bin-packed paths share add_group instead of repeating the map logic.
